pages.text: The Akaishi Purifier is a self-fueling single-block refiner. Akaishi Crystals or Raw Akaishi Blocks placed in the fuel slot are burned into energy, which converts a Raw Akaishi Block in the input slot into $(bold)1 essence$(reset), or an Akaishi Crystal Block into $(bold)4 essence$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Notes:$(reset)$(li)It has its own fuel slot and can operate without a power grid$(li)Speed upgrades increase its rate, and an energy pipe can also supply it$(li)Essence cannot be used as fuel; only crystals and raw blocks are burned

For higher throughput, the $(bold)Purifier Matrix$(reset) is a standalone bulk-refining multiblock: frame a 3×3×3 cavity with Purifier Matrix Casing, then add the controller, an energy input port and item input/output ports. Once formed, the controller refines in bulk at 30x speed: Raw Akaishi Block → 1 essence, Akaishi Crystal Block → 4 essence.$(br2)$(bold)Key difference:$(reset) the matrix has no fuel slot and operates entirely on grid power. The full wall checklist and build guide is in $(l:akaishi:purifier_matrix)Purifier Matrix$(/l).

Reading order: mine crystals from ore → craft them into raw blocks → extract essence with the Purifier → feed the essence into the concentration chain. For larger scale, see the Purifier Matrix entry.
